candidate.definition_en: A consideration or estimate of the similarities or dissimilarities between two things.
candidate.explanation_ar: إنك تقارن بين حاجتين عشان تشوف إيه الشبه والاختلاف بينهم.

senses.definition_en: A consideration or estimate of the similarities or dissimilarities between two things.
senses.definition_ar: المقارنة بين شيئين أو أكثر لتحديد أوجه الشبه والاختلاف.

examples: Make a comparison between the two cars.
In comparison to the old one, this is better.
There is no comparison between them.
candidate.mnemonic: جاية من 'Compare' يعني يقارن.. فالـ 'Comparison' هي المقارنة.
